problem:
The row echelon form matrix $P$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 7 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $P$ has $3$ pivots in the $2$nd, $3$rd, and $4$th columns:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 7 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot column is the $1$st column.
